purpose: Rhythm game timed tap chart (not melodic transcription)
timingReference: Seconds since original MP3 start; compare against audio.currentTime
syncMethod: librosa adaptive beat tracking + stable-section tempo regression and four-bar residual checks; first section follows detected onsets; ambiguous transition suppressed
phaseNote: Musical bar phase inferred from beat grid, not manually verified; 2nd-beat accent uses inferred main-section phase.

silenceFilter.approach: Reject low-energy/low-onset positions, omit ambiguous transition and end-tail notes
